name: GoatCounter
description: GoatCounter is lightweight, privacy-friendly web analytics without tracking cookies or unique identifiers. It records pageviews, referrers, campaigns, browsers, screen sizes and locations through a small script, a no-JavaScript pixel, a REST API or imported server logs, and shows them on a simple, accessible dashboard.

notes.text: Sign in at http://<IP>:8080 with the email and password from /opt/goatcounter_data/.env.
The tracking code on the dashboard points to https://<site domain>/count. Serve GoatCounter on that domain through an HTTPS reverse proxy, or change the URLs to http://<IP>:8080.

app_vars.name: var_admin_pass
app_vars.label: Admin Password
app_vars.help: 8 to 50 characters; generated when left empty

app_vars.name: var_goatcounter_domain
app_vars.label: Site Domain
app_vars.help: Domain GoatCounter is served on, e.g. stats.example.com; the container IP when left empty
